Karnataka’s famous Maddur Vada super crispy on the outside, yet soft, moist, and fluffy on the inside.
I’ve shared all the right tips and measurements to help you get that perfect texture at home.
It’s an absolute treat during the monsoon, especially with a hot cup of filter coffee or chai on the side.
Do give this recipe a try, the full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Cooking!
